workload: benchmarks/resource-calibration-v1/workload.py build(787), three requests, cases SHA fixed in driver
per_block: deploy on condition change, cold load, one unscored warm-up pass (marker header), measured three requests, stop
metric: engine output tok/s (block-level and per-request B/A ratio on adjacent block pairs, median)
threshold: B vs A: |median ratio - 1| >= 2% with >= 5/6 pairs in the same direction = meaningful; otherwise no meaningful difference
extension: if the median ratio is within 1%-3% of 1 and pair directions are mixed (<5/6), add BAAB ABBA (4 blocks) once within a 2 h total budget
stop: 12 blocks (or extension) complete; restore plain deploy at any exit
